derivation: Section 6: 'A supported boundary has a grounding value of asserted-only, attributed, or attested that the evaluation context accepts. grounding = not-evaluated is valid only with status = not-evaluated; either field paired differently produces E_PROFILE_MAPPING_INVALID.' Section 6.2 places a well-typed input that violates a cross-field invariant at position 4, which precedes both a supplied fatal set and an inadmissible asserted claim. Section 8.4 returns the fixed rejection projection for every rejection branch: verdict reject, the single derived fatal token, every derived set empty and every input-derived component unavailable, carried as null under the public representation contract. Note that evaluation_scope['boundary-grounding'] is not-evaluated here because Section 12 governs that capability by boundary status, binding and grounding; setting it evaluated would violate a second, different invariant and would not isolate the pairing rule.
purpose: A boundary finding cannot be supported while its grounding was never evaluated. The input is well typed and every aggregate is correctly scoped, so it fails only the cross-field pairing between boundary status and boundary grounding, at ordered check 4, before any claim is appraised.
